source.doc_type: CAR disclosure with reviewed condensed interim financial statements 1Q2025 (Thai)

notes: Quarterly (3 months to 31 March 2025 = year to date). First IFRS 17 interim year (2567 comparatives restated). Scanned; read locally, pages located by their headings (file page numbers). CAR disclosure p.1-3, reviewed interim statements from p.4 (auditor PwC). Thousand Baht. SCI p.7. Revenue and expenses 23.1 (p.83, printed sideways; columns non-PAA / PAA / total, 3 months, both years): incurred claims and acquisition amortisation include PAA; no acquisition-cash-flow recovery is printed in revenue this quarter. CSM roll-forward 19.1.2 p.74 (sideways; ยอดสุทธิ ณ วันที่ 31 มีนาคม พ.ศ. 2568); future-service change = change in estimates + onerous line (116) + experience adjustment (CSM column). The CSM column also carries 'other changes affecting the contract balances' of (110,496), which has no line item here: it is left out and recorded as an accepted break of the CSM roll-forward. New business 19.1.3 p.76 (sideways): no total column; the onerous column is nil, so the non-onerous column is the total. Other revenue = อื่นๆ (23.1). RA release uses 23.1 (148,348). Other expense = other finance costs + other operating expenses. In Q1 the three-month profit or loss is the year-to-date column.
